news.title: Ghana Joins Nigeria In Lamentations Over U17 National Team's World Cup Absence, Due To Dwindling Form
news.lede: Nigeria’s fellow English-speaking West African neighbour, Ghana, has joined their eternal rivals in lamentations over another FIFA U17 World Cup absence, due to the dwindling form of their cadet team, Black Starlets. Sports247 reports that, in an uncanny shift from the famous ‘jollof rivalry’ between both countries, Ghana and Nigeria now share the same ignominious absence from the continental and global spotlight of under-17 football. This follows the inability of both teams to advance from the ongoing West African Football Union (WAFU)-B U17 Championship in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, where Nigeria failed to reach the semi-finals, and Ghana could not make the final.

news.title: PFF NAMES 14-MAN PMNFT U15 FOR FIFA U15 WORLD CUP & FESTIVAL
news.lede: The Philippine Football Federation (PFF) has named the 14-player squad of the Philippine Under-15 Men’s National Football Team (PMNFT U15) for the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival, which will be played in Baku, Azerbaijan, from October 24 to 30, 2026. The tournament uses an 8v8 format. news.title: England rugby legend Lawrence Dallaglio’s World Cup medal sells for £54,000; Eric Cantona’s shorts go und
news.lede: A medal from one of English rugby’s most celebrated nights has changed hands for £54,000, while a pair of shorts associated with football icon Eric Cantona and other sporting keepsakes attracted collectors at an auction in England. The sale, held by sports memorabilia specialist Budds on October 13, featured 332 lots spanning rugby, football, cricket, boxing, golf and tennis, according to the auction house’s official results.The headline item was the 2003 Rugby World Cup winner’s medal belonging to former England captain Lawrence Dallaglio. The silver-gilt medal fetched a hammer price of £54,000, close to the lower end of its pre-sale estimate of £50,000 to £80,000.
